newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DEALER FINGER - SLIP UPS S.AFRICA PEPKOR.
newsitem.headline: DEALER FINGER - SLIP UPS S.AFRICA PEPKOR.

text.p: South African brokerage Simpson McKie James Capel said on Wednesday it had by mistake entered an incorrect price on a trade in Pepkor Ltd, pushing the price up to 39.25 rand -- well above its market level.
George Bennett, director of international trading, said that the deals had, however, since been reversed by all the brokers who were taken out at the incorrect price.
"What happened has become known amongst brokers as finger trouble," Bennett said.
"One of our dealers put in an order to buy 25,000 Pepkor. He was supposed to have entered 29.25 rand and he entered 39.25 by mistake. He approved the order and it pushed the market up to 31.00 rand."
Pepkor shares were last trading at 29.25 rand, a drop of 75 cents on the day in volume of 131,000 shares.
